title: Big Deal or No Deal
summary:
How Iran sanctions relief might impact the tanker market
Yesterday, the P5+1 and Iran announced that they had reached a framework agreement on the containment of Iran's nuclear program in exchange for the gradual lifting of sanctions, the details of which will need to be completed by June 30 th . The question is: What does this mean for the tanker market? Under the agreement, Iran will receive gradual sanctions relief once it has complied with the conditions under the agreement.
